sentences.text: It is submitted by learned APP that the report in compliance of the order dated 19.04.2023, has been filed.

4. I have perused the report dated 11.05.2023 filed by the State and relevant portion of the same reads as follows:-
"5.

The Ld. Chief PP/SD made observations that, as the present case was registered on the statement of the victim's parents and the same parents are charge sheeted in the same case, they may protect the main accused Rahul during trial to save themselves.

In view of this, Ld. Chief PP/SD remarked that the main accused Rahul shall be charge sheeted u/s 304B/498A/376/34 IPC & 6 POCSO Act in the present case, and victim Neha's parents, Sh. Chokelal, Smt. Rajwati, shall be charge sheeted u/s 10 Child Marriage Prohibition Act and 21 POCSO Act vide a separate chargesheet.
6.

In view of the above, the accused husband Rahul was chargesheeted u/s 304B/498A/376/34 IPC & 6 POCSO Act, and chargesheet submitted before the Hon'ble Court of Saket, on 25.02.2023 and the same is pending trial and NDOH is 22.05.2023.
xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx 10

. It is further submitted that, as the accused husband Rahul is already charge sheeted in POCSO ACT with the relevant section of IPC, and co-accused persons were recently arrested, a separate case u/s 9, 10 Prohibition of Child Marriage Act & 21 POCSO ACT was already registered as they solemnized the marriage of a minor girl, which is pending investigation.
The delay in the registration of a case against the parents of the deceased is inadvertently due to the complex nature of the case and seeking legal advice in this matter from legal experts."
5. Since the order dated 19.04.2023 has been complied with and a report has been filed in this regard, no further orders are required to be passed.
RAJNISH BHATNAGAR, J MAY 19, 2023/ib
